title: wss: ephemeral events carry no accountId
description: chatId/callId/regionId are unique only per account; RFC 8887 StateChange is keyed by accountId. Events in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md, draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md, draft-atwood-jmap-scene-wss-00.md lack accountId. Related: jmap-chat-spec-jlsm.3 (scene account model).
close_reason: accountId added to ChatTypingEvent/ChatPresenceEvent, all Scene events, and as a WebSocket delivery property for VTC events; id lists match across accounts. Scene account model itself remains jmap-chat-spec-jlsm.3.
